name: glossa
description: AI-native translation management by Meter. Push any translation file (JSON, xcstrings, strings.xml, PO, XLIFF, ARB and formats Glossa learns), let Claude translate it with your glossary and rules, review a shared task queue, audit a locale and pull the files back, from the conversation, the CLI or CI.

api_key.title: Glossa API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave empty to sign in with your browser (/mcp). Or paste a gls_… key from https://getglossa.dev/dashboard?ref=plugin for a machine without a browser: Claude Code keeps it in your system's secure credential store and sends it only to the Glossa MCP server, in the X-Api-Key header.
